status.summary: Lost the undisputed lightweight title, and his unbeaten record, to Justin Gaethje at UFC Freedom 250 on the White House South Lawn (Jun 14, 2026). His corner stopped the fight after round 4. He suffered fractures of both orbital bones, with no surgery needed. Dana White says he returns in early 2027 and has named no opponent; Topuria wants the Gaethje rematch and has also called for Paddy Pimblett in April. Still the No. 1 lightweight contender. Former UFC featherweight champion (vacated Feb 2025) and lightweight champion (Jun 2025 to Jun 2026).
status.ranking: #1 lightweight contender (UFC media panel, Nov 3, 2026, as mirrored by ufcrankings.org and UFCalendar; not checked on ufc.com)

after dropping Gaethje with body shots in R2 he followed him to the mat and hunted submissions (per reports; ufcstats logs no takedown or submission attempt in that round), and Gaethje recovered
returns from fractures of both orbital bones and a layoff of at least 6 months; after-effects unknown
style.summary: A pressure boxer with knockout power and a grappling base. He walks opponents down, cuts off the cage and throws combinations to the head and body, and he finished Volkanovski, Holloway and Oliveira inside three rounds each. His first loss came when Gaethje stood and traded and broke both orbital bones. The open questions are how he returns from that injury and how he handles a puncher who will not back up.

moves.notes: Weights are normalized to sum to 1 within the head, body and leg groups, as the director's picker expects (fact-check, Nov 6, 2026; ratios unchanged). Target split from fighters.json: decayed significant attempts are 77% head, 17% body, 6% legs (landed 66/24/10; career 78/15/7). The lightweight league is 76/15/9, so kicks sit low. Hook and cross get the top head weights because the Oliveira KO was jab, right hand, left hook in his own words (Al Jazeera), and the Volkanovski and Holloway finishes were punches at distance (ufcstats). The body hook is high because his body work comes in bursts: 24 of 29 body strikes landed in R2 vs Gaethje put him down (CBS, Yahoo, ufcstats). Calf kicks get a little weight because he landed 15 of 16 leg strikes vs Holloway. Knee is small: clinch strikes are 10% of his landed decayed. ufcstats does not record technique, so the split inside each target is a judgment.

engine_notes.note: Power is elite: 1.15 knockdowns per 15 min career (league 0.39) and 2.33 per 100 significant head strikes landed (league 0.95; 1.77 after shrinkage). He has scored a knockdown in 8 of his 10 UFC fights.

engine_notes.note: Takedown defense is 95% career (20 of 21 stopped). Gaethje went 0 for 5.

Damage swing at UFC Freedom 250: he landed 44 significant strikes in R2 but only 7 in R3 after his eyes swelled. Topuria said he lost sight in both eyes; accounts differ on when (by the end of R2 in one, by R4 in another).

Chin before 2026: only 1 knockdown absorbed (Jai Herbert, 2022), and no knockdown recorded in the Gaethje loss either. The stoppage was for facial damage, so a durability penalty after the orbital fractures should be a judgment, not a measured chin drop.
He stepped away in late 2025 for personal reasons, which led to the interim title fight between Gaethje and Pimblett at UFC 324.
